title: Light Italian Pork Amatriciana
description: A spicy and indulgent Italian dish made with pork, soffritto base, and caster sugar, served in a tajine clay vessel, onion and garlic free.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
In a large bowl, mix together the soffritto base, red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pork jowl to the bowl and toss to coat with the soffritto mixture.
Heat a large tajine clay vessel over medium heat and add the pork jowl, cooking until browned on all sides.
Add the caster sugar, tomato puree, white wine, and pork broth to the vessel, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then cover the vessel with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until the pork is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Remove the vessel from the oven and stir in the chopped parsley.
Serve the amatriciana hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
